provider_boundary.assessment: Checked-in facade and provider boundary are separated from the externally owned browser transport; only the certified runtime environment is forwarded.

runtime_provider.assessment: The external approved Playwright/RPC runtime is not available in operator custody; the repository does not provide or simulate it.

activation_manifest.assessment: No externally held activation manifest is configured for this audit environment; operator approval and digest reconciliation therefore cannot be verified.

browser_contract.assessment: The facade and verifier enforce browser, tab, Playwright, visible-DOM, and capability surfaces; live validation is correctly withheld until the runtime is available.

browser_auth.assessment: browserAuth is mandatory and credential values are not accepted or returned; provider verification discovers the capability without invoking it.

certified_origin.assessment: Origin checks are exact and HTTPS-scoped to https://sentinel-dna-staging:18443; reachability must be reverified on the approved staging host.

evidence_generation.assessment: Non-secret provider, activation, and readiness reports are generated with exclusive creation and safe status categories; no browser session or credential material is included.

blockers.detail: Approved browser runtime module and trusted RPC transport are not present in external operator custody.
Externally held activation manifest with valid integrity, approval reference, certified origin, and image binding is not configured.
Runtime provenance, review reference, immutable runtime digest, teardown ownership, and operator approval record are not available for verification.
Certified staging-origin reachability was not established from this audit workspace and remains an operator-host prerequisite.

remediation: Obtain the separately reviewed Playwright/RPC runtime module from approved custody; record its identity, provenance, immutable digest, reviewer, teardown owner, and scope without copying secrets.

Create or retrieve the externally held activation manifest for the certified origin, bind it to image digest sha256:17bf71b3ce57a3c1e3c6f840caa541a862cce74d6cfddc3dce9fd3d816e13653, and record human approval through the approved custody workflow.
Dot-source configure_gate4_provider_environment.ps1 with the external runtime module, external activation manifest, and the exact reviewed image digest.
Run provider verification and the activation dry-run on the approved staging host; proceed only when every required check returns PASS and the activation result is READY_FOR_ANALYST_PILOT.
